neighbours.label: The first piece of a verb of handing out or gathering that the tokenizer splits: ' coll' (collate), ' disp' (dispense), Chinese '分' of 分发 'distribute', Japanese '配' of 配信; the same sentences with an unsplit verb stay quiet.
fire: 救援人员在灾区向居民分发饮用水。
学校每天早上给学生分发牛奶。
志愿者在车站门口分发传单。
The clerk will collate the survey forms before the meeting.
Editors collated the readers' letters into a single issue.
The machine dispenses tickets after you pay.
A trust was created to dispense grants to local artists.
新しい動画を毎週配信しています。
quiet: 救援人员在灾区为居民提供饮用水。
学校每天早上给学生准备牛奶。
志愿者在车站门口张贴传单。
The clerk will check the survey forms before the meeting.
Editors printed the readers' letters in a single issue.
The machine prints tickets after you pay.
A trust was created to award grants to local artists.
新しい動画を毎週作っています。
